description: Audit a website: takes url (a live URL, a bare hostname, or a local directory of built output), optional checks (check ids to filter to) and optional maxPages (1-200, default 25), and returns { ok, target, mode, live, errors, warnings, pages, findings } where every finding carries checkId, severity, file, category and fixAvailable. Covers the layer a browser does not show: robots.txt and llms.txt policy, canonical and noindex signals, structured data, Open Graph, security and cache headers, accessibility semantics, and the tracker/cookie surface.

checks.description: Only report these check ids (e.g. ["audit/noindex"]). Omit for every check. Call list_checks for the full set.

maxPages.description: Cap the live crawl at this many pages. Default 25. Ignored for a local directory.

url.description: The site to audit: a URL (https://example.com, or bare example.com), or a path to a local directory of built output.

name: audit_site
title: Audit a website's invisible foundation
